About.heading: Rural banking, consumer goods and trade agencies, under one roof
About.paragraph1: Our co-operative brings the rural bank, consumer goods store, product agencies and a fuel station together for the benefit of the village. Protecting members' savings, supporting local traders and building a stronger community is the whole of our mission.
About.paragraph2: The society was registered on 6 October 1976 under the Department of Co-operatives. Fifty years on, it is still run the same way — by elected members, for members.
About.principles: Co-operative autonomy · democratic control · member economic participation · concern for community.
About.visionDesc: To become the leading trading institution providing high-standard business services within our area.
About.missionDesc: To develop this co-operative into a quality-driven, productive and efficient business by fulfilling the social commitment of enhancing member economic growth — through reliable banking, fair trade and community-centred service.
